description.value: One of the two continuations of the person who began dividing in 2284 and finished in 2285, and holder of the fourth fissure since. They are a bender by training and were a bender before the division, the whole of that career being theirs and also the other continuation's. They have not been photographed, the survey having no way to work at a running vent without lights and no permission to use them.
